mountains.evidence: biomeAt function: wz < -33 is mountains, wz < -14 is forest, wz < -10 && wx < -8 is highlands. These regions share boundaries along the wz=-33 and wz=-14 lines.

forest.evidence: biomeAt function: wz < -14 is forest, wz < -33 is mountains, wz < -10 && wx < -8 is highlands, wz >= 10 is grassland.

highlands.evidence: biomeAt function: wz < -10 && wx < -8 is highlands, bordering mountains (wz < -33) and forest (wz < -14).

jungle.evidence: biomeAt function: default return is jungle, wx > 32 is swamp, wz >= 10 is grassland, wx < -12 is grove.

swamp.evidence: biomeAt function: wx > 32 is swamp, otherwise jungle.

grove.evidence: biomeAt function: wx < -12 && wz < 8 is grove, otherwise jungle or grassland.

grassland.evidence: biomeAt function: wz >= 10 is grassland, bordering forest (wz < -14), jungle (default), grove (wx < -12), and desert (wx >= 16 && wz >= 10).

delta.evidence: delta is defined by the coastal edge (Rim function) and river mouths (mouths array) which intersect the jungle, swamp, and grassland regions.

desert.evidence: biomeAt function: wx >= 16 && wz >= 10 is desert, bordering grassland (wz >= 10).

volcano.evidence: biomeAt function: Math.hypot(x-VX, z-VZ) < 15 is volcano, located near VX=-22, VZ=26, which falls within the grassland/jungle transition zone.
